title: Amygdala excitability across development: mechanisms, environmental influences, and behavioral outcomes
title_zh: 杏仁核兴奋性在发育过程中的变化：机制、环境影响与行为结果
abstract: Recent work in rodent models provides mechanistic insights into how the excitability of principal neurons is dynamically regulated to facilitate the encoding and retrieval of emotionally salient memories in the basolateral amygdala (BLA). In this review, we discuss the physiological mechanisms governing BLA excitability, emphasizing their impact on the recruitment of defined BLA ensembles encoding distinct behavioral states. In addition, we summarize the current understanding of how these mechanisms are established during development and suggest that this may follow distinct developmental phases. Lastly, we outline recent findings on how early-life adversity or genetic risk factors can acutely perturb developmental trajectories and may lead to enduring changes in BLA circuit function, with implications for neurodevelopmental disorders.
abstract_zh: 最近在啮齿动物模型中的研究为我们提供了关于基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）主神经元兴奋性如何动态调节以促进情绪显著记忆的编码与检索的机制性见解。在本综述中，我们讨论了调控BLA兴奋性的生理机制，并强调其对招募特定BLA集群以编码不同行为状态的影响。此外，我们总结了当前对这些机制在发育过程中如何建立的理解，并提出这可能遵循不同的发育阶段。最后，我们概述了关于早期逆境或遗传风险因素如何急性扰乱发育轨迹并可能导致BLA回路功能的持久变化的最新发现，并讨论其对神经发育障碍的意义。
